item: Records with corrupt time stamps among good ones (off the time grid and out of the order the file was written in) are left out; each is in the audit trail
Records stamped before the first year (min_year) or more than two days in the future are left out as a reset clock (off: kept at the time they carry; records with no time are always left out)
Campbell out-of-range codes (-7999, 7999, -6999, 6999) are removed (off: kept as values). Infinite values are always removed
Where two files hold different values for the same time, one file's are kept: the newest download's by default
Values that disagree with another sensor on the same station (two air temperatures, two humidities, a mean outside its minimum and maximum) are flagged
Days on which a station departs from the same parameter at the other stations are flagged
Flags decided not a problem (Needs you) are left out of the exported flag columns; flags.csv keeps them, marked accepted
